div.p: Little William Street is located between William and Queen streets. It is a dead-end street that opens to Little Bourke Street. Grice Alley connects Little William and William Streets. The street was previously known as Fultons Lane. In 1891, there were four residents living in Little William Street, and two vacant allotments. By 1950, there was an electrician, shoe repairer, stereotypers, storage space and a car garage in the street.
